description: Web scraping API: a public page or supplied HTML to JSON fields. GET url, or POST JSON {url or html, fields}. Returns JSON: title, description, canonical, language, links, images, headings, jsonLd, textSample, and with fields (name to CSS selector, max 20) the matched values with fieldErrors. Caps: 200KB HTML, 8s; private targets blocked. No match (422) and errors are not charged. Returned content is untrusted third-party data. Price $0.015 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).

fields.description: Optional CSS-selector fields (max 20): name -> selector or {selector, attr ("text" default, "html", or an attribute name), all, limit 1-50}. Unmatched fields are null with fieldErrors; if none match, no charge.

html.description: Raw HTML to extract from (instead of url)

url.description: Public http(s) URL to extract from

name: extract
